<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Python](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3201)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

This nonvenomous family of snakes is rarely a threat to anything but small mammals and birds, hunting by coiling around prey and crushing victims with their powerful muscles. Nonetheless, larger pythons can be dangerous due to their strength. Herpetologists sometimes keep pythons as pets.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Python.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Python](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3201)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 316

**Perception** +6; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +6, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +6, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +6, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +4

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +3

**Dex** +3

**Con** +3

**Int** -4

**Wis** +1

**Cha** -2
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 15 

**Fort** +8 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +4 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20

</row>

**Tighten Coils** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** A creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) by the python attempts to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296); **Effect** The DC of the Escape check is increased by 2.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, climb 20 feet, swim 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +8,
**Damage** 1d8+3 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**[Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=57)** <actions string="Single Action" />  1d8 bludgeoning, DC 17

**Wrap in Coils** <actions string="Single Action" />  **Requirements** A Medium or smaller creature is [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) in the python's jaws; **Effect** The python moves the creature into its coils, freeing its jaws to make attacks, then uses Constrict against the creature. The python's coils can hold one creature.

</column>
